glosses: most often, usually, normally (most of the time)

examples.text: Meistens bekomme ich, was ich will.
examples.en: I usually get what I want.
It happens most often at night.

examples.text: Was für Bücher lesen Sie meistens?
examples.en: What kind of books do you read most often?
Most of the time I eat out.

examples.text: Ich stehe meistens um acht auf.
examples.en: I usually get up at eight.
